title: The Kite at Night
lines: Meg made a big kite from sticks and cloth.
She had to fly it at night with Dad.
First Meg tied a small light to the kite.
That light was not bright at all.
So Meg tied on a big red light.
At night the kite went up high.
Ben ran up to see the bright light.
"That is not a star," said Meg.
The wind was strong and the string snapped.
The kite fell, and Meg gave a sad sigh.
But the bright light lets Ben find it.
At home Meg and Dad had hot pie.

questions.ask: Why did Meg swap the small light for a big red one?
questions.listenFor: The small light was not bright at all.

questions.ask: How did Ben find the kite after it fell?
questions.listenFor: The bright light let him see it. That is why the big light mattered.

questions.ask: Do you think Meg will fly her kite at night again? Tell me why.
questions.listenFor: Either answer is fine. Listen for a reason from the story.
